reason: The price is fair and my old site with last year's prices does embarrass me, but my guests mostly find me on Google Maps and TripAdvisor, and I have never heard of Almissa Digital. I am not handing €600 to a name I saw in passing; my nephew keeps saying he can do it with Wix.
objection: Who are these people, and will they still be answering WhatsApp in two years when I change the menu prices in June? I have been burned before by a friend who made the site and then disappeared.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three sites they already made for konobas or restaurants near Omiš or Makarska, and hearing from one of those owners that changes really happen within two days.
